front: Em primeiro lugar, gostaria de deixar claro qual é a minha posição.
pronunciation: eng pree-MAY-roo loo-GAHR, gohs-tah-REE-ah jee DAY-shahr KLAH-roo KWAHL EH ah MEE-nyah poh-zee-SOWNG.
back: First of all, I'd like to make my position clear.
context: 'Em primeiro lugar' opens an argument; follow it with 'em segundo lugar' and 'por fim'. 'Gostaria de' is the polite conditional.

front: Entendo o seu ponto de vista, mas discordo em parte.
pronunciation: ehn-TEHN-doo oo SEH-oo POHN-too jee VEES-tah, mahz jees-KOHR-doo eng PAHR-chee.
back: I understand your point of view, but I partly disagree.
context: A polite way to disagree: acknowledge first ('entendo'), then object. 'Discordar em parte' = to partly disagree.

front: Com todo o respeito, os dados não sustentam essa conclusão.
pronunciation: kohng TOH-doo oo rrehs-PAY-too, ooz DAH-dooz NOWNG soos-TEHN-towng EH-sah kohn-kloo-ZOWNG.
back: With all due respect, the data doesn't support that conclusion.
context: 'Com todo o respeito' softens a strong objection. Note that 'dados' (data) is plural in Portuguese: 'os dados não sustentam'.

front: Por outro lado, não podemos ignorar os custos sociais da medida.
pronunciation: pohr OH-troo LAH-doo, NOWNG poh-DEH-mooz eeg-noh-RAHR ooz KOOS-toos soh-SYAHYS dah meh-JEE-dah.
back: On the other hand, we can't ignore the social costs of the measure.
context: 'Por outro lado' introduces the opposing side of an argument; it pairs with 'por um lado'.

front: Ainda que a proposta tenha méritos, ela é inviável a curto prazo.
pronunciation: ah-EEN-dah keh ah proh-POHS-tah TEH-nyah MEH-ree-tooz, EH-lah EH een-vee-AH-vehl ah KOOR-too PRAH-zoo.
back: Even though the proposal has merits, it isn't feasible in the short term.
context: 'Ainda que' (even though) is a concessive conjunction that requires the subjunctive: 'tenha'.

front: Isso não passa de uma generalização sem fundamento.
pronunciation: EE-soo NOWNG PAH-sah jee OO-mah zheh-neh-rah-lee-zah-SOWNG seng foon-dah-MEHN-too.
back: That's nothing more than a baseless generalization.
context: 'Não passar de' = to be nothing more than. A firm way to dismiss an argument without insulting the person.

front: Você está distorcendo o que eu disse.
pronunciation: voh-SEH ehs-TAH jees-tohr-SEHN-doo oo keh EH-oo JEE-see.
back: You're twisting what I said.
context: Useful to defend yourself in a debate. A milder version: 'Acho que você me entendeu mal'.

front: Vamos nos ater aos fatos, por favor.
pronunciation: VAH-mooz nooz ah-TEHR ah-ooz FAH-tooz, pohr fah-VOHR.
back: Let's stick to the facts, please.
context: 'Ater-se a' (to stick to) is conjugated like 'ter'. Common when a discussion drifts into opinion or personal attacks.

front: Esse argumento é um clássico exemplo de falácia do espantalho.
pronunciation: EH-see ahr-goo-MEHN-too EH oong KLAH-see-koo eh-ZEHM-ploo jee fah-LAH-syah doo ehs-pahn-TAH-lyoo.
back: That argument is a classic example of a straw man fallacy.
context: 'Falácia do espantalho' (straw man): misrepresenting someone's view to attack it more easily.

front: Atacar a pessoa em vez de rebater a ideia é um argumento ad hominem.
pronunciation: ah-tah-KAHR ah peh-SOH-ah eng VEHS jee rreh-bah-TEHR ah ee-DAY-ah EH oong ahr-goo-MEHN-too ahj OH-mee-neng.
back: Attacking the person instead of refuting the idea is an ad hominem argument.
context: 'Rebater' = to rebut/counter. 'Em vez de' = instead of. Logical fallacies keep their Latin names in Portuguese.

front: Correlação não implica causalidade.
pronunciation: koh-rreh-lah-SOWNG NOWNG eem-PLEE-kah kow-zah-lee-DAH-jee.
back: Correlation does not imply causation.
context: A key principle of media literacy, often quoted when headlines jump from statistics to conclusions.

front: Qual é a fonte dessa informação?
pronunciation: KWAHL EH ah FOHN-chee DEH-sah een-fohr-mah-SOWNG?
back: What's the source of that information?
context: The first question to ask about any viral news. 'Fonte' = source (also 'fountain').

front: A manchete é sensacionalista e não condiz com o conteúdo da matéria.
pronunciation: ah mahn-SHEH-chee EH sehn-sah-syoh-nah-LEES-tah ee NOWNG kohn-JEES kohng oo kohn-teh-OO-doo dah mah-TEH-ryah.
back: The headline is sensationalist and doesn't match the content of the article.
context: 'Manchete' = headline; 'matéria' = news article. 'Condizer com' = to be consistent with.

front: Antes de compartilhar, confira se a notícia foi publicada por veículos confiáveis.
pronunciation: AHN-cheez jee kohm-pahr-chee-LYAHR, kohn-FEE-rah see ah noh-CHEE-syah FOY poo-blee-KAH-dah pohr veh-EE-koo-loos kohn-fee-AH-vays.
back: Before sharing, check whether the news was published by reliable outlets.
context: 'Veículo' (vehicle) also means media outlet. 'Confira' is the imperative of 'conferir' (to check).

front: Essa notícia é falsa: a foto foi tirada há cinco anos, em outro país.
pronunciation: EH-sah noh-CHEE-syah EH FAHL-sah: ah FOH-too FOY chee-RAH-dah AH SEEN-koo AH-nooz, eng OH-troo pah-EES.
back: That news is fake: the photo was taken five years ago, in another country.
context: A typical fact-check: images taken out of context. In Brazil fake news is also called 'fake news' (feminine: 'a fake news').

front: O comercial apela para a emoção em vez de apresentar informações concretas.
pronunciation: oo koh-mehr-SYOW ah-PEH-lah PAH-rah ah ee-moh-SOWNG eng VEHS jee ah-preh-zehn-TAHR een-fohr-mah-SOYNGS kohn-KREH-tahs.
back: The ad appeals to emotion instead of presenting concrete information.
context: 'Comercial' = TV/radio ad; 'anúncio' = ad in general. 'Apelar para' = to appeal to.

front: Repare que o anúncio usa letras miúdas para esconder as condições.
pronunciation: rreh-PAH-ree keh oo ah-NOON-syoo OO-zah LEH-trahz mee-OO-dahs PAH-rah ehs-kohn-DEHR ahs kohn-jee-SOYNGS.
back: Notice that the ad uses fine print to hide the conditions.
context: 'Letras miúdas' (tiny letters) = fine print. 'Repare que' = notice that.

front: A propaganda associa o produto a um estilo de vida inalcançável.
pronunciation: ah proh-pah-GAHN-dah ah-soh-SEE-ah oo proh-DOO-too ah oong ehs-CHEE-loo jee VEE-dah ee-nahl-kahn-SAH-vehl.
back: The ad links the product to an unattainable lifestyle.
context: In Brazil 'propaganda' usually just means advertising, without the negative political sense it has in English.

front: Quem financiou essa pesquisa tinha interesse no resultado.
pronunciation: KENG fee-nahn-SYOH EH-sah pehs-KEE-zah CHEE-nyah een-teh-REH-see noo rreh-zool-TAH-doo.
back: Whoever funded this study had an interest in the outcome.
context: Pointing out a conflict of interest. 'Pesquisa' = research/study/survey.

front: A amostra é pequena demais para tirar conclusões gerais.
pronunciation: ah ah-MOHS-trah EH peh-KEH-nah jee-MAHYS PAH-rah chee-RAHR kohn-kloo-ZOYNGS zheh-RAHYS.
back: The sample is too small to draw general conclusions.
context: 'Tirar conclusões' = to draw conclusions. 'Amostra' = sample (in statistics).

front: Concordo com você até certo ponto.
pronunciation: kohn-KOHR-doo kohng voh-SEH ah-TEH SEHR-too POHN-too.
back: I agree with you up to a point.
context: A diplomatic half-agreement, usually followed by 'mas…'.

front: Deixe-me terminar o meu raciocínio, por favor.
pronunciation: DAY-shee-mee tehr-mee-NAHR oo MEH-oo rrah-syoh-SEE-nyoo, pohr fah-VOHR.
back: Let me finish my line of thought, please.
context: Polite way to stop an interruption. In casual speech: 'Me deixa terminar'.

front: Desculpe interromper, mas posso fazer uma observação?
pronunciation: dehs-KOOL-pee een-teh-rrohm-PEHR, mahz POH-soo fah-ZEHR OO-mah ohb-sehr-vah-SOWNG?
back: Sorry to interrupt, but may I make a comment?
context: The polite way to take the floor in a meeting or debate.

front: Vamos supor, só para argumentar, que você tenha razão.
pronunciation: VAH-mooz soo-POHR, SOH PAH-rah ahr-goo-mehn-TAHR, keh voh-SEH TEH-nyah rrah-ZOWNG.
back: Let's assume, just for the sake of argument, that you're right.
context: 'Só para argumentar' = for the sake of argument. 'Supor que' + subjunctive for hypotheses.

front: Isso é verdade, porém não resolve o problema principal.
pronunciation: EE-soo EH vehr-DAH-jee, poh-RENG NOWNG rreh-ZOHL-vee oo proh-BLEH-mah preen-see-POW.
back: That's true; however, it doesn't solve the main problem.
context: 'Porém' is a more formal 'mas'. It can also come after the verb: 'não resolve, porém, o problema'.

front: Os números falam por si.
pronunciation: ooz NOO-meh-rooz FAH-lowng pohr SEE.
back: The numbers speak for themselves.
context: A common closing line in debates and presentations.

front: Não confunda opinião com fato.
pronunciation: NOWNG kohn-FOON-dah oh-pee-nee-OWNG kohng FAH-too.
back: Don't confuse opinion with fact.
context: Negative imperative ('não confunda') uses the present subjunctive.

front: A matéria omite informações essenciais para entender o contexto.
pronunciation: ah mah-TEH-ryah oh-MEE-chee een-fohr-mah-SOYNGS eh-sehn-SYAHYS PAH-rah ehn-tehn-DEHR oo kohn-TEHS-too.
back: The article leaves out information that's essential to understanding the context.
context: 'Omitir' = to leave out. Lying by omission is a frequent technique of biased media.

front: Esse veículo tem uma linha editorial claramente conservadora.
pronunciation: EH-see veh-EE-koo-loo teng OO-mah LEE-nyah eh-jee-toh-RYOW klah-rah-MEHN-chee kohn-sehr-vah-DOH-rah.
back: That outlet has a clearly conservative editorial line.
context: 'Linha editorial' = editorial line/stance of a newspaper or channel.

front: É preciso ler a notícia inteira, não só o título.
pronunciation: EH preh-SEE-zoo LEHR ah noh-CHEE-syah een-TAY-rah, NOWNG SOH oo CHEE-too-loo.
back: You need to read the whole article, not just the headline.
context: 'É preciso' + infinitive = it's necessary to. 'Título' is also used for headline.

front: Trata-se de um conteúdo patrocinado, não de jornalismo independente.
pronunciation: TRAH-tah-see jee oong kohn-teh-OO-doo pah-troh-see-NAH-doo, NOWNG jee zhohr-nah-LEEZ-moo een-deh-pehn-DEHN-chee.
back: This is sponsored content, not independent journalism.
context: 'Trata-se de' = it's about / it is. It's impersonal and stays singular: never 'tratam-se de'.

front: A pergunta da pesquisa foi formulada de maneira tendenciosa.
pronunciation: ah pehr-GOON-tah dah pehs-KEE-zah FOY fohr-moo-LAH-dah jee mah-NAY-rah tehn-dehn-SYOH-zah.
back: The survey question was worded in a biased way.
context: 'Tendencioso' = biased, leading. Leading questions are a classic way to manipulate poll results.

front: Discordar é saudável, desde que seja com respeito.
pronunciation: jees-kohr-DAHR EH sow-DAH-vehl, DEHZ-jee keh SEH-zhah kohng rrehs-PAY-too.
back: Disagreeing is healthy, as long as it's done with respect.
context: 'Desde que' = as long as / provided that, followed by the subjunctive ('seja').

front: Você tem alguma evidência que comprove isso?
pronunciation: voh-SEH teng ahl-GOO-mah eh-vee-DEHN-syah keh kohm-PROH-vee EE-soo?
back: Do you have any evidence to prove that?
context: 'Que comprove' is subjunctive because the evidence may not exist.

front: A meu ver, a solução passa necessariamente pela educação.
pronunciation: ah MEH-oo VEHR, ah soh-loo-SOWNG PAH-sah neh-seh-sah-ryah-MEHN-chee PEH-lah eh-doo-kah-SOWNG.
back: In my view, the solution necessarily involves education.
context: 'A meu ver' = in my view (more formal than 'eu acho'). 'Passar por' = to involve / go through.

front: Esse dado está fora de contexto.
pronunciation: EH-see DAH-doo ehs-TAH FOH-rah jee kohn-TEHS-too.
back: That figure is out of context.
context: 'Dado' = a piece of data, a figure. 'Fora de contexto' = out of context.

front: Não estou dizendo que você está errado, só que falta nuance.
pronunciation: NOWNG ehs-TOH jee-ZEHN-doo keh voh-SEH ehs-TAH eh-RRAH-doo, SOH keh FAHL-tah noo-AHN-see.
back: I'm not saying you're wrong, just that it lacks nuance.
context: A softening move: deny the strong reading of your criticism before making a smaller point.

front: Em suma, os benefícios superam os riscos.
pronunciation: eng SOO-mah, ooz beh-neh-FEE-syooz soo-PEH-rowng ooz RREES-koos.
back: In short, the benefits outweigh the risks.
context: 'Em suma' / 'em resumo' introduce a conclusion. 'Superar' = to outweigh, to overcome.

front: Ninguém aqui é dono da verdade.
pronunciation: neen-GENG ah-KEE EH DOH-noo dah vehr-DAH-jee.
back: No one here has a monopoly on the truth.
context: 'Ser dono da verdade' (to own the truth) describes someone who thinks they're always right.

front: Esse influenciador não deixa claro que é uma publicidade paga.
pronunciation: EH-see een-floo-ehn-syah-DOHR NOWNG DAY-shah KLAH-roo keh EH OO-mah poo-blee-see-DAH-jee PAH-gah.
back: That influencer doesn't make it clear that it's a paid ad.
context: Brazilian rules require labels like '#publi' for paid posts. 'Deixar claro' = to make clear.

front: Percebe a contradição no discurso dele?
pronunciation: pehr-SEH-bee ah kohn-trah-jee-SOWNG noo jees-KOOR-soo DEH-lee?
back: Do you notice the contradiction in his speech?
context: 'Discurso' = speech, but also the overall narrative or rhetoric someone uses.

front: O debate esquentou quando o assunto foi a reforma tributária.
pronunciation: oo deh-BAH-chee ehs-kehn-TOH KWAHN-doo oo ah-SOON-too FOY ah rreh-FOHR-mah tree-boo-TAH-ryah.
back: The debate heated up when the topic turned to tax reform.
context: 'Esquentar' = to heat up (literally and figuratively). 'Reforma tributária' is a recurring topic in Brazilian politics.

front: Ele mudou de assunto para não ter que responder.
pronunciation: EH-lee moo-DOH jee ah-SOON-too PAH-rah NOWNG TEHR keh rrehs-pohn-DEHR.
back: He changed the subject so he wouldn't have to answer.
context: Spotting evasion is part of media literacy. 'Mudar de assunto' = to change the subject.

front: Essa pergunta é capciosa e eu não vou cair nela.
pronunciation: EH-sah pehr-GOON-tah EH kahp-SYOH-zah ee EH-oo NOWNG VOH kah-EER NEH-lah.
back: That's a trick question and I'm not going to fall for it.
context: 'Capcioso' = tricky, deceptive. 'Cair em' = to fall for (a trick).

front: Concordamos em discordar.
pronunciation: kohn-kohr-DAH-mooz eng jees-kohr-DAHR.
back: We agree to disagree.
context: The graceful way to end an argument that won't be resolved.

front: O que está em jogo aqui é a credibilidade da instituição.
pronunciation: oo keh ehs-TAH eng ZHOH-goo ah-KEE EH ah kreh-jee-bee-lee-DAH-jee dah eens-chee-too-ee-SOWNG.
back: What's at stake here is the institution's credibility.
context: 'Estar em jogo' = to be at stake.

front: A checagem de fatos desmentiu a declaração do ministro.
pronunciation: ah sheh-KAH-zheng jee FAH-tooz jehz-mehn-CHEE-oo ah deh-klah-rah-SOWNG doo mee-NEES-troo.
back: The fact-check debunked the minister's statement.
context: 'Checagem de fatos' = fact-checking. 'Desmentir' = to deny, to debunk.

front: Não generalize a partir de um único caso.
pronunciation: NOWNG zheh-neh-rah-LEE-zee ah pahr-CHEER jee oong OO-nee-koo KAH-zoo.
back: Don't generalize from a single case.
context: 'A partir de' = from, based on. An anecdote is not evidence.

front: Mesmo que você não concorde, vale a pena ouvir o outro lado.
pronunciation: MEHZ-moo keh voh-SEH NOWNG kohn-KOHR-jee, VAH-lee ah PEH-nah oh-VEER oo OH-troo LAH-doo.
back: Even if you don't agree, it's worth hearing the other side.
context: 'Mesmo que' + subjunctive (concorde). 'Valer a pena' = to be worth it.

front: Encerro minha fala com uma pergunta: a quem interessa essa desinformação?
pronunciation: ehn-SEH-rroo MEE-nyah FAH-lah kohng OO-mah pehr-GOON-tah: ah KENG een-teh-REH-sah EH-sah jee-zeen-fohr-mah-SOWNG?
back: I'll close my remarks with a question: who benefits from this disinformation?
context: A rhetorical closing. 'A quem interessa?' (who does it interest?) asks who benefits.
